explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/60: He, Ma and Yang proved the conjecture for n = q² + q + 1 with q even. The docstring explains the restriction to q a power of 2: there ex(q²+q+1; C₄) = ½q(q+1)² is known, so their theorem (graphs with ½q(q+1)² + 1 edges have ≥ q − 1 copies, for large even q) applies to every graph above the extremal number. Copies of C₄ are counted as subgraphs H' of G isomorphic to cycleGraph 4, i.e. non-induced copies, each a vertex set with its 4 edges, and ex(n; C₄) is extremalNumber n (cycleGraph 4). Small q are covered by taking c small, since one copy is forced above ex. Faithful.
